subject: Re: Insights Suite packaging — retention + trace modules
messages:
From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@opsly.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@opsly.com
Date: 2026-10-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Observability add-ons — retention + tracing pricing request

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team liked the trace visualizations. Procurement asked me to gather a firm price for the add-ons we discussed: 6/12/24 month retention tiers for traces, and the advanced dashboard pack (custom widgets + role-level sharing). We also want a sense of what a committed-usage discount looks like (monthly token/ingest commitments) and whether retention can be mixed (e.g., 30d traces + 1y metrics).

Attached is our high-level requirements doc. Can you share a SKU-level quote and any flexibility on credits or one-time migration fees? Looking to close licensing by the end of the month.

Cheers,
Jordan Park
Director of Platform Engineering
Opsly

Attachment: opsly_initial_requirements.pdf (application/pdf, 312KB)

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@opsly.com>
Cc: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention + tracing pricing request

Jordan — thanks for the note and the doc. Great to hear the team liked the tracing UX.

High level answers up front:
- We can offer modular retention tiers for traces (30d / 90d / 365d) and separate retention for metrics. Mix-and-match is supported; you can set per-resource retention policies.
- Advanced Dashboards is a seat + SKU product (dashboard seats + widget pack).
- Committed discounts are available at 12m and 24m terms and scale with token/ingest commitments; we also provide an upfront credit bucket for migration events.

I attached a starter SKU table (redwood_insights_sku_table.xlsx) that maps the tiers to list price + example committed pricing. If you want, I can schedule a 30m call with Marcus (pricing lead) to walk the numbers and model a 12m vs 24m commitment.

Two quick clarifying Qs:
1) Do you expect to route all trace traffic through Redwood, or only sampled traces for long-term storage?
2) Are there internal SLAs on trace query latency we should account for in pricing?

Available times for a short call later this week: Wed 10/13 10:30am or Thu 10/14 2:00pm PT.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_insights_sku_table.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention + tracing pricing request

Looping in guidance for the SKU table and concessions. Notes for the call:
- Baseline list pricing: 30d traces = $0.40/GB-month, 90d = $0.30/GB-month, 365d = $0.18/GB-month. Metrics retention priced separately.
- Advanced Dashboards: $1,200 per dashboard seat/year + $150 per premium widget pack.
- Committed discount bands: 10% at $50k ARR commitment, 18% at $150k, 25% at $300k+.
- Migration credit: one-time credit up to 15% of first-year committed spend for data transfer and onboarding if customer signs 24m term.

We should preserve margin by tying higher discounts to minimum ARR and a ramp schedule (commit months 1–3 low, ramp by month 6). For SLAs above standard latency we can offer an SLA addendum at a small premium.

Camila — recommend proposing: 12m @ 18% off list with a $75k ARR floor OR 24m @ 22% off with a $150k ARR floor + one-time migration credit of up to 10%. That gives Opsly flexibility and keeps us protected.

-Marcus
Senior Pricing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@opsly.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@opsly.com
Date: 2026-10-13T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention + tracing pricing request

Camila, Marcus — thanks for the detail. A few follow-ups from procurement:
- Opsly can commit to a 12 month deal with a $120k ARR floor across the Insights Suite if we get a 20% discount on list and a $20k migration credit.
- We want the ability to split retention across services (30d traces, 1y metrics) — looks like that’s supported. Confirmed.
- Are advanced dashboards licensed per workspace or per user? Pricing note: our analytics team wants at least 10 dashboard seats.

If we can get the 20% + $20k credit we can move to legal this week. Otherwise we may need to extend timelines.

Jordan
Director of Platform Engineering, Opsly

Date: 2026-10-14T15:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention + tracing pricing request

Jordan — appreciate the candid ask and the timeline. Quick final from our side: we can accept a 20% discount on the Insights Suite for a 12m commitment, subject to a $140k ARR floor (slightly higher than your $120k ask). In addition, we can provide a $15k migration credit applied in Q1 billing.

Licensing for Advanced Dashboards is per-dashboard seat (licenses are transferable within a single Opsly workspace). Given you plan for 10 seats, I’ll model that into the SOW.

If you’re good with the $140k ARR floor + $15k credit, I’ll send an updated SOW and our standard commercial redline for legal review today. If the $120k floor is non-negotiable for Opsly, let me know and I’ll escalate to sales leadership for a discretionary concession.

Next steps:
- Confirm acceptance of $140k ARR floor + $15k migration credit by EOD 10/15 and I’ll circulate SOW.
- Provide any required PO/contracting details for legal intake.

Thanks — and happy to jump on a 15 minute sync if it helps speed things up.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
